02 / 06 Concept study

Isola

Ice cream parlour · Mosede Havn, Denmark

A universe of flavours in orbit.

02 The opportunity

Let visitors taste the flavour before they reach the counter: each flavour becomes the main scene of the page.

03 The direction

Composition
A scoop of ice cream at the centre, ingredients around it and plenty of light space.
Typography
A weighty Nordic grotesque (Schibsted Grotesk), in short sentences, in the parlour’s own language (Danish).
Colour
Pistachio green as the base; each of the four flavours brings its own colour to the scene.
Central gesture
The ingredients orbit the scoop and the flavour changes within the same scene.

04 The interface

The page was conceived as a single scene that unfolds as you scroll, with the content always readable without relying on the animation.

Open published prototype (opens in a new tab)

05 The motion

  1. 01 Suspended scoop
  2. 02 Orbit
  3. 03 Flavour change

The scoop appears suspended above the cone, with the ingredients in orbit; four flavours swap background, scoop and ingredients in the same scene; at the end, the scoop settles into the cone and the whole moves on to its card in the catalogue.

06 Josean’s role

Visual direction, interface and the flavour change.
